g.text: Bounded Agent admission on four GPUs
2 RTX A6000 + 2 L40 · 4 parameter shards · 262,144 × 128 FP32 rows · 1,024 IDs/update
Prior: three 5-second windows; bounded: two. Full drain included; bars are medians, whiskers observed ranges.
Prior admission rejected 128 Learners; that failed point is excluded from throughput and latency bars.
